description: Saved sampling diagnostics for all ten parameters. R-hat compares within-chain and between-chain variation using rank-normalized and folded split chains. Bulk effective sample size (ESS) summarizes sampling efficiency for the main distribution; tail ESS uses the smaller 5% and 95% indicator-tail estimate. Here lambda = tau/sigma^2, where tau is the kernel variance amplitude and sigma^2 is the error variance; r denotes exposure kernel relevance and beta denotes regression coefficients. These diagnostics do not establish convergence or validate model assumptions.
alt_text: Aligned dot plots show rank-normalized split R-hat, bulk effective sample size, and tail effective sample size for all ten saved parameters. Bulk and tail panels share the same scale.
transformations: Display all ten diagnostics.csv rows, preserving source order and values.
Use separate R-hat, bulk ESS, and tail ESS axes; show 1 as a reference for R-hat, without a pass/fail threshold.
scope: Presentation of saved tables only; no model fitting or posterior recomputation.
publisher_requirements: Nature-inspired presentation only. Live research-figure guidance was inspected on 2026-10-25; final-submission compliance remains unverified.
